messages:
sara: quick q — ACME asked for a full purge of user traces for customer-1234. Is there an approved path for this or do we need legal sign-off? pinging #eng-security. https://go/repro-erase-456
eli: for customer-initiated erasure we need DSAR verification + legal OK if it falls outside standard retention. did they send a signed request?
sara: they sent an email from admin@acme.com and included the cust-id in the ticket. i can forward the thread.
audit-bot: retention-policy v2.1: operations note — SRE must run erase job for traces/kv-cache. security approval required for data older than 90d.
jen: quick clar: are the traces in s3://debug-traces or live ephem-cache? if ephem-cache we can TTL immediately, s3 requires a manual delete job.
matt: ran verify-user.sh for customer-1234 — identity check matches ticket. suggest scheduling the delete job but need ops approver to sign off on timing.
ops-approver: approved to run purge for acme/customer-1234 pending legal confirm. :white_check_mark:
sara: i'll forward the signed email to legal@redwood.com and add the ticket link to the erase request. tagging @legal for confirmation.
legal: received the forwarded request. contract review complete — no retention override found. legal -> you have the go for erasure, please attach audit record and ticket id to the job.
matt: scheduling erase job Mon 09:00 UTC. command i'll run: `./tools/erase-customer --id customer-1234 --scope traces,caches --dry-run=false`
eli: note — please run with `--scrub-pii` so any inline PII in snapshots is redacted before manifests are stored.
matt: will run `./tools/erase-customer --id customer-1234 --scope traces,caches --scrub-pii` and upload S3 deletion manifest to the ticket after completion. will ping here when done.
sara: thanks all, assigning to matt. will close thread after manifest uploaded. :thumbsup:
